caseNameFull: Marvin GREEN v. Megan J. BRENNAN, Postmaster General.

opinions.text: Catherine M.A. Carroll, Esq., of Washington D.C. is invited to brief and argue this case, as amicus curiae, in support of the judgment below. Briefs of other amici curiae in support of the judgment below to be filed within 7 day of the filing of the brief of Court-appointed amicus curiae .
